batch1.categories: All four: impact and object sounds; technique and magic sounds; state and atmosphere sounds; feeling and body sounds
batch1.variety: Mixed: signatures plus fresh hits (a technique keeps a signature word; each fight also invents fresh ones for new things)
batch1.language: By the POV's culture (a Moto POV hears manga-style Japanese sound words; Kharven and Common POVs hear English ones)
batch1.beyond_fights: All four: city and market ambience; wilds and weather; emotional beats; comic beats

batch2.typography: Stretched and scaled freely (length and case carry size: a tiny tik, a middling thud, a vast GOOOOOOM)
batch2.placement: Varied by tempo (quick trades mid-clause; the turning blow leads on its own line)
batch2.state_words: Plain romanized (shiin, gogogogo, doki-doki without italics; matches the existing romanized-mimetic rule)
batch2.in_mouths: By character (a showman or clown says them; a cold killer never would; the card decides)
